rules.label: Rolling Return
rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan

insights: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 5.28% (15.61% vs 10.33%).
Beat the benchmark in 89.4% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Hybrid: Dynamic Asset Allocation.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.70 vs 0.58) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Aggressive profile: beta 1.45 with 15.7% annualised volatility vs benchmark 9.5%.
Positive alpha of 3.08% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.64).
Drawdown protection: max drawdown -34.20% vs benchmark -18.85% — shallower losses in downturns.
Rolling return range spans 1.42% to 29.77% (28.35 pp spread) — consistency score 94.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
